official.deadline_note: The official calendar publishes a recurring annual window of 10 January - 20 February without stating a year; the 2026 cycle ran 10 January - 20 February 2026, so 20 February 2027 is the expected next closing date. Research Scholarships run four separate annual periods and the Success Scholarship window is October-November, each announced individually.
official.application_cycle: One annual application period for the general programmes: 10 January - 20 February every year (2026 cycle: 10 January - 20 February 2026); next general cycle expected to open 10 January 2027.
official.status_note: The 2026 general application window closed on 20 February 2026 and its results were announced in early August 2026. The official application calendar repeats the same 10 January - 20 February window each year, so the next general round is expected in January 2027. Success Scholarship (application October-November, results November) and Research Scholarship (four windows: January-March, April-June, July-September, October-December) have separate announced periods.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: 'While studying at the most prestigious universities at world standards, your university tuition is covered by Turkiye Scholarships.'
benefits: Monthly stipend of 6.500 TL at Associate's and Bachelor's levels, 9.500 TL at Master's level and 13.000 TL at PhD level per month
Merit Scholarship Program: monthly stipend 2 times higher than the regular payment for academically qualified students
Full tuition fee coverage at the host university
University and department placement, unlike other higher education scholarship programmes
One year of free Turkish language education through Turkish Teaching Centers (TÖMER) at universities
General health insurance for all international scholarship students

Accommodation: free dormitory for the duration of studies at undergraduate level; master's and doctoral students receive dormitory in the first year, then a housing allowance of 6.000 TL in Istanbul and Ankara and 5.000 TL in other cities
Once-off flight ticket covering travel to Türkiye and return to the home country after graduation, requested through TBBS
Student clubs and societies, the International Student Academy, specialization programmes, student congresses and art competitions
Türkiye Alumni Network of more than 150,000 members across 160 countries
eligibility: Graduates or those who will graduate at the end of the current academic year (before August)
Minimum academic achievement: 70% for associate and bachelor's candidates, 75% for graduate candidates, 90% for candidates of Health Sciences (Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy)
Age criteria: under 21 for associate and bachelor's degree programmes, under 30 for master's programmes, under 35 for PhD programmes, under 50 for Research Scholarship
Ineligible: Turkish citizens and individuals who have lost Turkish citizenship
Ineligible: individuals who are currently enrolled in programmes in Turkish universities at the level of education they apply for
requirements: Online application submitted through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS), free of charge
Candidates are given the opportunity to select between 12 choices in online applications
Candidates can only choose from the universities and departments offered to them in the system, which vary by educational background
Undergraduate candidates sit a 30-question quantitative test of mathematics, geometry and logic questions before the face-to-face interviews conducted by the Presidential Delegations
Candidates invited for the interview are required to bring all the documents and certificates of the latest education they have completed
documents: A valid identity document, ID card or passport
A photograph of the candidate taken within the last 1 year
International exam results (GRE, GMAT, SAT, etc.) if required by the chosen university or programme
International language test results such as TOEFL, DELF if required by the chosen university or programme
A proposal for a research topic and a written example of the research carried out (only for PhD applications)
selection_criteria: Preliminary assessment of all applications on basic criteria: minimum academic achievement, age limits set for each level of education, and required documents

Expert Committee evaluation of academic status, previous qualifications, academic interests, career goals, consistency of preferences, content of the letter of intent, and participation in social activities
30-question quantitative test (mathematics, geometry, logic) held for undergraduate candidates prior to the face-to-face interview, with longer tests in some countries
Face-to-face interview of usually 15-30 minutes with committees of academics and experts, covering document check, purpose of application, academic knowledge and career goals
Final assessment by a selection committee of the interview results and the candidate's general eligibility
coverage: Once-off flight ticket to Türkiye and return home after graduation
Free academic, social and cultural programmes
application_method: Apply online free of charge through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) at tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Create a TBBS account, complete the application form, upload the required documents and select up to 12 university and department preferences
Applications for the general programmes are received in one period each year, between 10 January and 20 February
official.application_route: One free online application via TBBS (tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr) during the 10 January - 20 February window, ranking up to 12 university/department preferences.
official.study_mode: Full-time for associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD programmes; short-term Research Scholarships also offered.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to citizens of all countries; Turkish citizens and individuals who have lost Turkish citizenship are ineligible, as are candidates currently enrolled in a programme at a Turkish university at the level they apply for.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is designed for international students from all countries.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No subject-area restriction is published. Candidates in health sciences (medicine, dentistry, pharmacy) must meet a 90% minimum academic achievement. Many programmes are taught in Turkish while some departments and universities offer programmes in English and other languages; programme-specific special conditions (TOEFL, SAT, GRE, GMAT, ALES, etc.) are listed per programme in the scholarship programme search.
official.research_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a proposal for a research topic and a written example of the research they have carried out.
official.duration: Full-time degree programmes of standard length, preceded or accompanied by a one-year Turkish language course (TÖMER); Research Scholarships are short-term.
official.description: Türkiye Scholarships is the Republic of Türkiye's government-funded, competitive scholarship programme for international students, coordinated by the Presidency of Turks Abroad and Relatives of Overseas Citizens (YTB). It funds associate, bachelor's, master's, PhD and research study at the most prestigious Turkish universities and is distinctive in providing university and department placement rather than a fellowship to be spent at a chosen institution. Applications are submitted online, free of charge, through the Türkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS) in a single annual window.
official.english_requirement: No blanket English requirement is published. Candidates who wish to study in English-medium programmes must be able to provide an internationally accepted language proficiency certificate (TOEFL or other equivalent certifications if the university officially stated them acceptable); many programmes are taught in Turkish. All awardees who do not possess a C1 Level Certificate for Turkish Proficiency - including those placed into English or other language medium programmes - must attend the 1-year Turkish Language Course and attain the C1 Level Certificate by the end of their academic year.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a fully funded government scholarship that pays tuition, a monthly stipend of 6,500 TRY (bachelor's) up to 13,000 TRY (PhD), dormitory or housing allowance, health insurance and a return flight - and it also places you in one of up to 12 ranked university/department preferences through TBBS. The main constraint is a six-week annual window (10 January - 20 February) with no second chance for the general programmes, so a missed cycle costs you roughly eleven months. Selection is multi-stage: expert committee review of your file, then for undergraduates a 30-question maths, geometry and logic test drawn partly from the Turkish curriculum, then a 15-30 minute face-to-face interview at a presidential delegation. Plan your finances around a modest lira stipend, and note that master's and PhD students only get a dormitory in year one before switching to a 5,000-6,000 TRY housing allowance.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent graduates and final-year students inside the age caps (under 21 / 30 / 35) with strong grades who want fully funded study at a leading Turkish university and are willing either to learn Turkish or to document English for an English-medium programme.
application_readiness_checklist: Verify the level-specific age cap (under 21 for associate/bachelor's, under 30 master's, under 35 PhD) and grade threshold (70% undergraduate, 75% graduate, 90% health sciences) before anything else - these screen you out before any substantive review
Prepare a passport or ID valid through the cycle, a photograph taken within the last 12 months, diploma or temporary graduation certificate, and complete transcripts

Use the programme search page to shortlist preferences: check each option's language of instruction and its special conditions (TOEFL, SAT, GRE, GMAT, ALES) rather than assuming a blanket English rule
Rank up to 12 preferences realistically, since placement depends on what the system offers for your educational background and consistency of preferences is scored
PhD applicants: draft the research-topic proposal and assemble a written research sample before the window opens, as both are mandatory uploads
If targeting English-medium programmes, sit the required language or admission test early enough to hold results when TBBS opens
common_rejection_risks: Missing the six-week window entirely - the general programmes accept applications in only one period a year
Failing preliminary assessment on grade percentage or age caps, which are applied before the file reaches the expert committee
Weak or inconsistent preference rankings and a generic letter of intent - the expert committee explicitly scores consistency of preferences, career goals and motivation
Undergraduate test performance: the 30-question maths/geometry/logic exam is designed around the Turkish curriculum, which penalises applicants from very different school systems
Turning up to the interview without the full original documents and certificates of the latest completed education
Wrongly assuming health sciences are closed or exam-free: medicine, dentistry and pharmacy applicants face the highest bar (90%) and sit the same test track
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Visa and residence permit fees, personal spending beyond the monthly stipend, food and local transport, and any rent exceeding the 6,000 TRY (Istanbul/Ankara) or 5,000 TRY (other cities) housing allowance that master's and PhD students receive after the first dormitory year; travel beyond the once-off arrival and graduation-return tickets is self-funded.
document_audit: The photograph must have been taken within the last year - an older passport photo is a routine upload problem
Final-year students may apply with a temporary graduation certificate but must actually graduate before August, so your graduation date has to line up with the August initial-procedures stage
National exam results are only needed 'if any', but where a chosen programme lists GRE, GMAT or SAT as a special condition those results are mandatory
Language certificates are only required if the chosen programme is English-medium - check each preference individually instead of buying a TOEFL you do not need
A PhD application is incomplete without both the research-topic proposal and the written research example
alerts: The general window runs only 10 January - 20 February - about six weeks - and applying is free, so there is no advantage in waiting until the final days of the window

Research Scholarships have four separate windows (January-March, April-June, July-September, October-December) and the Success Scholarship window runs October-November, so check the announcements page in autumn even outside the main cycle
Awardees without a C1 Turkish certificate must complete a one-year Turkish language course, so factor an extra preparatory year into your study timeline
Stipend figures are published in Turkish lira and revised between cycles - treat the published amounts as indicative until the next cycle announcement confirms them
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One free online application in TBBS with up to 12 ranked preferences; YTB screens on age, grades and documents, an expert committee scores the file, shortlisted undergraduates sit the 30-question test, invited candidates attend a face-to-face interview at a presidential delegation, results are announced in early August, and grantees complete initial procedures in August before travelling to Türkiye in September.
